resolutions.title: Pair membership never says which pass list it is read over (stale passes, rejected returns)
resolutions.action: Membership is drawn from the trail reader's accepted passes (a rejected return takes no position); a walk of a landed member before its partner ends the pair; an apply ends nothing, the freshness rule keeping a stale member from covering. Design D10 records it.
resolutions.evidence: re-read the membership requirement: the window closed only at the mode's next launch and named no pass list
resolutions.resolution: Sal (chat): a pair stays open until a walk of its landed half, or a newer launch, ends it; the walk warns first and offers to stop; walking ends the pair and the walked half covers the slot as a single; an apply between the halves adds no rule (the freshness rule already applies).

options_presented.body: Membership over every relevant pass of the mode, stale included, rejected returns excluded; a stale member makes the pair non-covering on the fresh list.

options_presented.label: B

retired: mode's next launch, if any. Every other independent pass is a single.
